project_type: Pure PHP 8+ gym website with MySQL, no framework
build_system: None - pure PHP, shared hosting compatible, no build step required
build_command: php -l on all PHP files for syntax validation
verification_instructions: 1. Run php -l on all PHP files to check syntax. 2. Verify all files in the folder structure exist. 3. Verify database.sql is valid SQL.
setup_instructions: 1. Upload all files to web server. 2. Import database.sql into MySQL. 3. Update config.php with database credentials. 4. Login to admin panel at /admin/login.php with admin/admin123.
environment_constraints: No framework, no composer, no Node.js. Pure PHP with PDO for MySQL. Must work on shared hosting.
contribution_requirements: All code must be complete - no placeholders, no lorem ipsum. Security: PDO prepared statements, password hashing, session protection, CSRF tokens, input validation.
key_patterns: Config-driven site settings from database. All public pages include header.php and footer.php. Admin pages include admin-header.php and admin-footer.php. Functions.php provides helper functions. PDO connection in config.php.
directory_structure: Root: public pages + config + includes. admin/: admin panel pages. admin/includes/: admin header/footer. assets/css/: stylesheets. assets/js/: JavaScript. assets/images/: static images. uploads/: user uploaded files.
